name: SEARCH-BENCH search methodology device (docs/code search · Track I index × Track N native tools × external agents · RunShell engines)
target: a pinned corpus (git sha of docs+src, or sampled reference repos) is searched by pluggable strategies through the product Glob/Grep/Read, the docs-search index stages and RunShell engines; recall@1/@5, MRR, tool calls and model-visible bytes are scored per domain and category
inputs: optional agent transcript (search-bench.transcript/1) or the off-by-default OpenRouter LLM arm
observations: per-strategy recall@1/@5, MRR, calls, bytes after folding, decoy hits in the top 5
dated scorecards in <test-state>/search-bench/runs/ compared run to run
